data.title: Vollstreckungsbescheid – Musterwohnen Elbtal eG
data.summary: Amtsgericht Beispielaue issued a Vollstreckungsbescheid (enforcement order) dated 19 November 2026, in the matter brought by Musterwohnen Elbtal eG, ordering payment of a total of €317.50 (unpaid garage usage fee for May to October 2026, plus interest and procedural costs). It follows an earlier payment order (Mahnbescheid) you did not object to.
data.explanation: This is a court enforcement order following a Mahnbescheid you did not object to in time. The creditor, Musterwohnen Elbtal eG, can now start enforcement (Zwangsvollstreckung) to collect €317.50 even before the order becomes final. You still have the right to object (Einspruch) in writing to Amtsgericht Beispielaue, and the app shows until when. If you do not act by the deadline shown, the order becomes final and enforceable without further notice. Because this is a short, non-extendable deadline (Notfrist), consider getting legal advice quickly, e.g. from a lawyer or a consumer advice centre.
